info.title: Brewser
info.author: natureglass
info.description: Run web apps on your Switch
info.details:
Brewser turns your Switch into a platform for web apps. Browse a curated catalogue of 28 apps at launch, a Three.js planetarium, a MIDI control surface, WS2812B LED panel control through an ESP32, a Home Assistant dashboard, an audio visualizer, and even an unmodified Unity WebGL game.

Under the hood: a real browser-grade engine (V8 with JIT, Skia, WebGL1/2) with hardware APIs the stock browser will never have: Web MIDI, WebSerial, WebUSB, WebBluetooth, all verified on real hardware.

Fully themeable from plain files on your SD card: wallpapers (including animated GLSL shader wallpapers), styles, cursors, and keyboards. Install once, Brewser self-updates from cryptographically signed releases.

No piracy: it runs web apps only, never commercial games or ROMs. It never contacts Nintendo servers and works fine with DNS.MITM/90DNS. Anyone can submit apps at brewser.io, every submission is security-scanned before publication.

Requires Atmosphère 1.10+ (older may work).

changelog: 0.1.114 - Initial public release. Web runtime (V8 + JIT, Skia, WebGL1/2 via Mesa) with Web MIDI, WebSerial, WebUSB, WebBluetooth and WebNN, curated 28-app catalogue with security scanning, HLS video and broad codec support via FFmpeg, themeable shell (GLSL shader wallpapers), signed self-updates with downgrade protection.
